decision_needed.question: The report contradicts itself on which General Fund spending holds the 424,100 transfer to the Depreciation Fund. GF transportation (p17) prints a 200,000 'Transfer to depreciation fund', yet the Statement of Activities (p2) leaves pupil transportation unchanged at 586,547.34 and removes the full 424,100 from Maintenance of plant. Is the 200,000 transfer really in transportation (so only 224,100 comes out of maintenance), or is all 424,100 in maintenance of plant spending?
decision_needed.recorded_as: 200,000 left in transportation as an other financing line (p17); contra lines by function group: -40,000 instruction and -224,100 maintenance of plant, with matching other financing outflows; top-level receipts/disbursements come from the statement of activities, which excludes all 491,100 of transfers

notes: Modified cash basis school district; all funds (incl. School Nutrition and Activities) are governmental activities, so business_type is null. No combined governmental funds receipts/disbursements statement is in the trimmed PDF, so top-level receipts and disbursements are the lines of the Statement of Activities (p2): program receipts + general receipts = 12,306,019.53 and disbursements 13,706,578.63. 'Operating Grants and Contributions' 1,410,606.08 is split into federal 784,046.30 and state 626,559.78 using the fund schedules (pp4, 9, 11). Statement 'Other' 52,383 is recorded as donations/contributions (97% donations: 50,000 + 683 + 1,700 from fund schedules; mix named in review). Transfers of 491,100 between funds (computed from pp6-8) are excluded from those and shown in transfers_in/transfers_out; printed totals on p3 (12,797,119.53 receipts, 14,197,678.63 disbursements) include them. Hidden General Fund transfers (264,100) are shown as two contra lines by function group (-40,000 instruction, -224,100 maintenance of plant) identified by comparing p2 with p5 function totals, plus matching other financing lines. 'Debt service and fees' (1,508,521.13) is split into principal and interest/fees using the fund schedules (pp10-12), which add exactly to the printed line. Detail: General Fund receipts from p4; General Fund spending by program and object from the operational expenses exhibit (pp13-18), which supersedes the function-only lines on p5 (not recorded). Activities Fund recorded account by account from p19 (replaces the one-line p8 schedule); transfers into accounts (27,000) recorded as other financing outside the printed total. Prior-year comparative columns (2024, p20) not recorded. Lines with zero actual are omitted (budget-only). Totals-only budget comparison on p3 not recorded as detail. 890 Other expense lines are marked miscellaneous expenditure with review. Fund balance roll-forward: 7,891,175.66 + 12,306,019.53 - 13,706,578.63 = 6,490,616.56. Read pages 1-20 of 20
